MISTAKES.title: Stork in the field
MISTAKES.desc: Lifting your feet high off the floor. Remember: slide the soles along the floor, never lose floor contact!

MISTAKES.title: Seven-league boots
MISTAKES.desc: Taking overly wide steps. Giant steps ruin balance and drain your stamina. Keep small steps under your hips.

MISTAKES.title: Broomstick legs
MISTAKES.desc: Locked, stiff knees. All the bounce, groove, and glide in Szuraniec comes from soft, flexing knees!

LEFT.one: Left foot slides to the left. Weight stays on the right.
LEFT.two: Right foot closes in. Weight transfers to the left.
LEFT.three: Left foot slides again — quick, half a beat.
LEFT.and: Right foot closes on the 'and'. Weight stays on the left leg.

RIGHT.one: Right foot slides to the right. Weight stays on the left.
RIGHT.two: Left foot closes in. Weight transfers to the right.
RIGHT.three: Right foot slides again — quick, half a beat.
RIGHT.and: Left foot closes on the 'and'. Weight stays on the right leg.

SONG_NAMES.cudowna: Akcent: True Love is You (Wonderful is)
SONG_NAMES.mama: Daj to glosniej: Mama Warned Me

BREAKDOWN.title: One
BREAKDOWN.body: Leading foot slides sideways. The other one holds your weight.

BREAKDOWN.title: Two
BREAKDOWN.body: Trailing foot closes in. Weight transfers to the leading foot.

BREAKDOWN.title: Three
BREAKDOWN.body: Quick slide of the leading foot — half a beat.

BREAKDOWN.title: And
BREAKDOWN.body: Closing slide on the syncopation. The next bar mirrors it all.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy & Cookies
PRIVACY.SEC_1_TEXT: The administrator of your data is the owner of the dwanajeden.pl domain. The app requires no account creation, allowing fully anonymous training.
PRIVACY.SEC_2_TEXT: To improve training quality, we utilize Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics. Collected data is fully anonymized and used strictly for statistics.
PRIVACY.SEC_3_TEXT: We use cookies for audio engine operation, saving user preferences (e.g. tempo, dance role), and YouTube API integration. Detailed rules for data processing by Google services are set forth in the Google Privacy Policy.
PRIVACY.SEC_4_TEXT: We utilize browser Local Storage to maintain technical parameters and app state for a smooth experience without reloading on every refresh.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms of Service & Legal Statement
TERMS.SEC_1_TEXT: The 'Two on One' application is an interactive educational tool designed to teach the traditional wedding dance step (Szuraniec / Disco Fox). It is completely free to use.
TERMS.SEC_2_TEXT: Dancing is a physical activity. The administrator is not liable for any injuries, strains, or partner's stepped-on toes resulting from improper technique.
TERMS.SEC_3_TEXT: We declare transparently: this application was created through the synergy of human methodological expertise and artificial intelligence models. While AI assisted with code and rhythm logic, the vision was directed by a human.
TERMS.SEC_4_TEXT: This application utilizes official YouTube API Services. By using the video playback feature, users agree to be bound by the YouTube Terms of Service and Google Privacy Policy. The application does not host, duplicate, or redistribute audio/video files — all media is streamed directly from YouTube servers in compliance with CJEU case law (Case C-348/13 BestWater).
